# Winutil-MAX

> Open-source Windows optimization, debloating, and automation suite — Stranger Things / Max Mayfield Edition.

## Overview & Identity
- **Project**: Winutil-MAX (`https://winutil.rinkurapria.dev`)
- **Repository**: `https://github.com/R-Rinku/winutil-max`
- **Maintainer**: Rinku Rapria (`https://www.rinkurapria.dev`)
- **Theme & Naming**: **Winutil-MAX** is themed after **Max Mayfield** from *Stranger Things* ("Running Up That Hill"), featuring a Max Mayfield splash card, custom Max desktop shortcut icon, and a dark-mode aesthetic, paired with expanded ("maxed-out") Windows power-user utilities.
- **Upstream Foundation**: Built on top of Chris Titus Tech's WinUtil (`https://github.com/ChrisTitusTech/winutil`).

## Launch Commands (PowerShell Admin)
- Primary: `irm "https://rinkurapria.dev/win" | iex`
- GitHub Raw Fallback: `irm "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/R-Rinku/winutil-max/main/winutil.ps1" | iex`

## Key Capabilities
- **MAX Exclusive Tab**:
  - **Dual-Boot BitLocker (No TPM)**: Enables pre-boot startup passwords without TPM PCR conflicts (always back up recovery keys for both OS drives first).
  - **OneDrive Sync Exclusion Manager**: Excludes local folders (`node_modules`, `WindowsPowerShell`, etc.) from OneDrive sync.
  - **Smart Bulk Name Modifier**: Batch file/folder renamer with regex and live preview.
  - **Take Ownership**: Explorer context menu integration with OS root safeguards.
  - **Winutil-MAX 2.0 Backups**: Full JSON profile export/import across apps, tweaks, BitLocker, and OneDrive exclusions.
  - **Desktop Shortcut**: 1-click shortcut creator/remover using the Max Mayfield icon.
- **Standard Workspaces**: Install (WinGet/Chocolatey), Tweaks (reversible privacy & performance), Config & Fixes, Updates, and Win11 Creator (custom debloated ISO + driver injection).
